trap.label: should have + particípio
trap.wrong: She should have to ask, so she might had gotten it.
trap.right: She should have asked, so she might have gotten it.
trap.why: Em português “deveria ter perguntado” usa ter; o brasileiro troca have por had e adiciona to. Em inglês é modal + have + particípio, sem to.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com arrependimento: “I didn’t call her.” (should)
Reescreva com possibilidade: “Perhaps she got the job.” (might)
rewrite.answer: She might have gotten the job.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com could: “It was possible for him to help.”
